# Enrollment Requirements Checklist: Student Self-Enrollment

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of browse and self-enrollment, including the boundary between business refusals and input validation
**Created**: 2026-10-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are student-visible outcomes for missing or non-integer identifiers specified in the feature specification, or explicitly excluded from it? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define the complete set of refusal rules ordered by FR-014, so a reader can tell which failures belong in that order? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK003 Is a requirement specified for a grade attempt that also lacks a valid acting-student identifier? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK004 Is the observation that makes a successful inscription "observable" specified? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "nonempty" given a measurable definition in the requirements, rather than only in assumptions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are the success and refusal sentences specified as exact text, including final punctuation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Is "registered student" defined so a missing record, name, email, or programme is the same specified outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Is "a grade attempt" defined clearly enough to tell whether an empty or absent grade value counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is uniqueness of course codes and student email addresses specified as an exact comparison? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Does the 2026-10-16 clarification stay consistent with FR-014, so business refusals remain one first-match message? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK011 Does the specification's treatment of transport detail stay consistent with the plan's multiple-error response, without adding a business outcome the specification does not own? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan]
- [x] CHK012 Do the edge-case statements use the same order and the same sentences as FR-014? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Do the browse requirements and the out-of-scope statements agree that course order is not required? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can SC-002's 100% and 0% outcomes be judged from the written definition of an existing course? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK015 Can SC-004 be judged for a missing course, an incomplete course record, a duplicate enrollment, and a person who is not registered? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK016 Does each user story name an independent test that can be judged from the specification alone? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements specified for a course list with no existing courses? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements specified for two students enrolling in the same course? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK019 Are overlapping attempts for one student and one course specified, including a grade already stored on the surviving inscription? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are the non-reasons in FR-012 included in acceptance coverage? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §User Story 1]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are the unregistered-student cases written so a missing record, name, email, and programme share one specified message? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements specified both for a course record with no code and for a course record with no name? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK023 Are withdrawal, grade display, and administrator enrollment excluded so enrollment success does not imply them? [Edge Case, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Is the assumption that programmes, students, and courses already exist distinguished from behavior this feature must provide? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK025 Is recognition of the acting student documented as outside this specification? [Dependency, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK026 Is the absence of a duplicate-email failure message documented as intentional? [Assumption, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [x] CHK027 Is RF-001 recorded as resolved, with no open replacement of FR-014? [Conflict, Spec §Review flags, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK028 Does the specification keep business-refusal priority in FR-014 rather than in constitution principle A10? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Constitution §A10]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `[x]` does not mean implementation work is complete.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
